authored_seams.proposal: Retain the real compiled-source cache, source budget, CLIENT execution assertion, frame-trigger limits, canonical bindings, exact identity and passive consent observation without any display provider. Guard only optional Compiled manifest component and its constructor arguments by client_program_actions.
authored_seams.counterfactual: A frame-only program may be compiled/observed without Touch Display, but has no invented generic execution target. It stays unscheduled until an actual available target calls the scheduler.

authored_seams.proposal: Nested touch_display guards cover actual TouchDisplay imports, display maps/budgets, typed surface methods/candidates/eligibility/Writer/ExecutionKey/FrameState and their cleanup. Keep manager/world cleanup outside that gate.
authored_seams.counterfactual: Touch-off omits those typed APIs/state. It does not substitute a fake display, nearest target, ticker or host.

authored_seams.proposal: Guard action imports/static dispatcher, manifest typing/capabilities/scopes, four-argument Evaluation path, typed values/reset/observation and Writer/Compiled manifest components. Preserve the exact raw four-argument branch when enabled.
authored_seams.counterfactual: Actions-off uses existing ClientFrameEvaluator.evaluate(FrameTrigger,long) Optional-image API. It must not reference SFMValue, Evaluation, action lookup, manifest, LET or invocation providers.

authored_seams.proposal: Guard RenderImageStatement detection and retain requestsRender(Block) with a legitimate false result when render is unavailable. For actions-off derive capabilities from the real accepted AST: EXECUTE plus RENDER only if a render statement is found.
authored_seams.counterfactual: No capability for an unavailable action/render provider is invented. FrameTrigger already rejects unsupported LET/value conditions without actions and render statements without render.

authored_seams.proposal: The existing two-argument pure evaluator selects an Optional image with renderAllowed internally true. The Runtime must independently commit that image only if writer.renderAllowed() AND writers.size()==1, after the original consent/identity and work-budget checks; preserve counters/error diagnostics and no unauthorized texture retention.
authored_seams.counterfactual: Do not merely copy the image result into state.texture. The unchanged single approved writer/render-consent boundary remains mandatory. This is a reviewed design candidate, not authored or executed semantics.

authored_seams.proposal: Guard negotiated runtime import/calls. Off uses the real privateWorldAvailable() result and integrated-world identity; outside a private integrated world it returns false/Optional.empty via existing APIs.
authored_seams.counterfactual: No remote identity, network session or public-server permission is fabricated. Private mode remains non-published single-player on the client thread. Existing unavailability diagnostics may retain their exact historical wording.

authored_seams.proposal: Use explicit dependency-closed isolated source proof profiles for L/T/A/R/M masks. Full-project multiplayer wire layout validation is a separate existing acceptance gate and must not be bypassed by a source-only renderer fixture.
authored_seams.counterfactual: M-on source factoring is not activation of public multiplayer, a network effect test, or proof that its session/packet/signing providers compile.

scheduler_authority.all_on: Preserves exact original four-argument Evaluation, manifest scopes, policy/identity/availability checks, real work budgets, renderAllowed && writers.size()==1 argument, and retained-texture authority recheck.
scheduler_authority.actions_off: Uses existing ClientFrameEvaluator.evaluate(FrameTrigger,long) Optional API; increments original frame/evaluation counters. The newly authored commit condition independently requires writer.renderAllowed() && writers.size()==1 before retaining an image; it is a source counterfactual, not historical raw behavior or executed rendering proof.
scheduler_authority.no_actions_capabilities: From the actual accepted FrameTrigger/Block AST: EXECUTE always, RENDER only when real requestsRender traverses an available RenderImageStatement. No action manifest, SFMValue, fake permissions or action lookup.
scheduler_authority.touch_off: No TouchDisplay Java imports, typed display scheduler/maps/geometry/records/value observation. Identity/compile/consent APIs remain real but no generic frame executor is invented.
scheduler_authority.render_off: requestsRender(Block) returns false; typed RenderImageStatement/IfStatement imports are absent. Frame evaluation rejects unavailable render statements through the existing actual AST/evaluator contracts.
scheduler_authority.multiplayer_off: privateWorldAvailable() only and real integrated-world identity, otherwise Optional.empty; no fake session or widened public-server boundary.

lifetime_boundary.explanation: Original identityFor/compiled do not observeWorld. If no actual display scheduler sets activeWorld, unload clears ClientManagerLoadedRegistry(world) but does not eagerly call clearWorld for COMPILED/COMPILED_WORLDS/COMPILE_COUNTS. Those are weak-key caches and liveIdentityFor revalidates current thread/world/chunk/live BE/exact identity. This stage preserves that boundary and makes no eager invalidation claim.
